import sys

def install(pkg): subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', '--quiet', 'install', pkg])

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Dependencies
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    install('gseapy'); import gseapy as gp
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    install('mygene'); import mygene

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Map Ensembl IDs to symbols
ensembl = [i.split('.')[0] for i in expr.index]
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
mg_res = mg.querymany(ensembl, scopes='ensembl.gene', fields='symbol', species='human', as_dataframe=True)
sym_map = mg_res['symbol'].to_dict()
expr['symbol'] = [sym_map.get(e) for e in ensembl]
expr = expr.dropna(subset=['symbol']).set_index('symbol')
expr = expr.groupby(expr.index).mean()

# 3. BRAF status
samples = expr.columns
pat_map = {s: s[:12] for s in samples}
braf = mut[(mut['Hugo_Symbol']=='BRAF') & (mut['Variant_Classification']=='Missense_Mutation')]
mut_pats = set(braf['patient_id'])
status = pd.Series({s: ('Mutant' if pat_map[s] in mut_pats else 'Wild-type') for s in samples})
status = status[expr.columns]

# 4. MAPK gene set
libs = gp.get_library_name(organism='Human')
kegg_lib = next(l for l in libs if l.startswith('KEGG'))
kegg = gp.get_library(name=kegg_lib, organism='Human')
mapk_key = next(k for k in kegg if 'MAPK SIGNALING PATHWAY' in k.upper())
mapk_genes = set(kegg[mapk_key])
common = sorted(mapk_genes & set(expr.index))
print(f"Overlapping MAPK genes: {len(common)}")

# 5. DE MAPK genes
de_list = []
for g in common:
    vals = expr.loc[g]
    m_vals = vals[status=='Mutant']
    w_vals = vals[status=='Wild-type']
    stat, p = ttest_ind(m_vals, w_vals, nan_policy='omit')
    de_list.append((g, m_vals.mean()-w_vals.mean(), p))
de_df = pd.DataFrame(de_list, columns=['gene','logFC','pvalue']).set_index('gene')
de_df['FDR'] = multipletests(de_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
de_df = de_df.sort_values('FDR')

# 6. Volcano plot
plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sig = de_df['FDR']<0.05
plt.scatter(de_df['logFC'], -np.log10(de_df['FDR']), c=sig.map({True:'red',False:'gray'}), alpha=0.7)
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Log2FC (Mutant - WT)')
plt.ylabel('-Log10 FDR')
plt.title('Volcano: MAPK Genes')
for g in de_df[sig].index[:5]:
    x, y = de_df.loc[g,'logFC'], -np.log10(de_df.loc[g,'FDR'])
    plt.text(x, y, g)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 7. Module score (mean and median)
mod_mean = expr.loc[common].mean()
mod_med = expr.loc[common].median()
mdf = pd.DataFrame({'mean_score':mod_mean, 'median_score':mod_med, 'status':status})
# Mean
plt.figure(figsize=(5,5)); sns.boxplot(x='status', y='mean_score', data=mdf); sns.stripplot(x='status', y='mean_score', data=mdf, color='k', size=3, jitter=True)
p1 = mannwhitneyu(mdf[mdf.status=='Mutant']['mean_score'], mdf[mdf.status=='Wild-type']['mean_score']).pvalue
plt.title(f'Mean score (p={p1:.2e})'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
# Median
plt.figure(figsize=(5,5)); sns.boxplot(x='status', y='median_score', data=mdf); sns.stripplot(x='status', y='median_score', data=mdf, color='k', size=3, jitter=True)
p2 = mannwhitneyu(mdf[mdf.status=='Mutant']['median_score'], mdf[mdf.status=='Wild-type']['median_score']).pvalue
plt.title(f'Median score (p={p2:.2e})'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 8. Adjusted linear model (mean_score ~ status + age + clark_level)
cov = clinical[['bcr_patient_barcode','age_at_diagnosis','clark_level']].dropna().drop_duplicates('bcr_patient_barcode')
lm = pd.DataFrame({'sample':expr.columns,'mean_score':mod_mean.values,'status':status.values})
lm['patient'] = lm['sample'].str[:12]
lm = lm.merge(cov, left_on='patient', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode')
model = ols('mean_score ~ C(status) + age_at_diagnosis + C(clark_level)', data=lm).fit()
print("\nLinear model summary:")
print(model.summary())

# 9. GSEA prerank
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
t_stats=[]
for g in expr.index:
    v=expr.loc[g]; st,_=ttest_ind(v[status=='Mutant'],v[status=='Wild-type'],nan_policy='omit'); t_stats.append(st)
rnk=pd.DataFrame({'Term':expr.index,'Score':t_stats}).dropna().sort_values('Score',ascending=False)
pre = gp.prerank(rnk=rnk, gene_sets={mapk_key:common}, outdir=None, permutation_num=1000, seed=42, verbose=False)
gsea = pre.res2d.iloc[0]
print("\nGSEA prerank results:")
print(gsea[['ES','NES','NOM p-val','FDR q-val']])
# Enrichment plot
from gseapy.plot import gseaplot
gseaplot(pre.ranking, **pre.results[mapk_key]); plt.show()

# 10. Print DE MAPK genes
sig_de = de_df[de_df['FDR']<0.05]
print(f"\nDE MAPK genes (FDR<0.05): {len(sig_de)} genes")
print(sig_de[['logFC','pvalue','FDR']])
